# Transcend Documentation

- [The Comprehensive Privacy Platform](/docs): An introduction to Transcend Docs
- Overview
  - [Overview](/docs/overview): General information that is useful across all Transcend product offerings.
  - [Platform Concepts](/docs/overview/concepts): Concepts used throughout Transcend's products and documentation.
  - [Glossary](/docs/overview/glossary): Glossary of terminology used throughout the Transcend platform
  - [Usage Entitlements](/docs/overview/usage-entitlements): Terminology around Transcend's offerings
  - [Supported Browsers](/docs/overview/supported-browsers): The browsers that we support for various Transcend products and the platform itself

  - Transcend Platform
    - [Transcend Platform](/docs/overview/platform): Documentation home for the Transcend Platform

    - Slack Notifications

- Privacy Center
  - [Privacy Center](/docs/privacy-center): Privacy Center is a secure portal that gives your users a self-serve way to exercise their data rights.
  - [Privacy Center Concepts](/docs/privacy-center/concepts): Concepts you should know for your Privacy Center.
  - [Privacy Center Preference Tabs](/docs/privacy-center/preference-tabs): Learn what the Privacy Settings, Sale of Info, and Communications Preferences tabs show in your hosted Privacy Center, with and without sign-in.
